name: Vanamali Gadi Shargi
text:
वनमाली गदी शार्ङ्गी शङ्खी चक्री च नन्दकी ।
श्रीमान् नारायणो विष्णुर्वासुदेवोऽभिरक्षतु ॥
meaning: May Vishnu, wearing the forest garland and bearing the mace, the bow Sharnga, the conch, the discus and the sword Nandaka, the glorious Narayana, Vasudeva, protect us.
purpose: A prayer for protection naming Vishnu’s attributes.
when: At the close of a practice.
note: The client list spells it “Vanamali Gadi Shyamhi / Shanghi”.
source: Closing verse of the Vishnu Sahasranama
